snippet.title: DenshAttack! - Hands on Gameplay Trailer with Limealicious! - Convergence Showcase
snippet.description: Flip, trick and grind your train in a fast-paced, off-the-rails ride through a colourful Japanese dystopia. Outmatch rival gangs, wreck a shady megacorp, and take back the tracks with nothing but skill, speed, and style. https//store.steampowered.com/app/2524850/Denshattack/
